newsitem.title: GERMANY: German parliament approves pension reform.
newsitem.headline: German parliament approves pension reform.

text.p: The German parliament on Friday approved the government's pension reform and job support bill, a central part of Bonn's austerity drive which should cut around 14 billion marks ($9.25 billion) from public spending next year.

Chancellor Helmut Kohl won an absolute majority for the bill, the first of three votes on the austerity package today, which overturned objections to the pension changes lodged by the opposition Social Democrat-controlled upper house of parliament on Thursday.
